entities.summary: Hinako Takanaga is a Japanese yaoi manga artist from Nagoya. She has also provided illustrations for several yaoi light novels by other authors, including The Guilty by Katsura Izumi. Most of her works have been translated into English and German. Her influences include Suzue Miuchi, Yun Koga and Range Murata. Hinako Takanaga was a painters & sculptors from Nagoya (b. 1972-09-16, Nagoya). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
